test_pipeline_cleanup_on_gc: test that the pipeline background thread is automatically stopped on garbage collection without warnings
test_pipeline_explicit_stop: test that cleanup is not called when the pipeline is explicitly stopped before deletion
test_pipeline_auto_stop_context: test that cleanup works correctly when using the auto_stop context manager
test_pipeline_auto_start_iteration: test that iterating a pipeline without explicit start automatically starts and cleans up on garbage collection
test_pipeline_continuous_source: test auto start and cleanup with a continuous source iterated across multiple epochs
